serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Qlik Cloud Government is a SaaS platform purpose-built for delivering Qlik technology to U.S. public sector customers within a safe, FedRAMP-compliant cloud environment. Qlik empowers organizations with data and analytics technology that improves decision-making and solves their most challenging problems. Qlik Cloud Government simplifies data and analytics operations across an organization through a single platform that integrates data sources into an analytics environment where users of all levels can build analytics assets and collaborate with others to drive action.
